boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase activities and resources verified through Siena University and Albany Public Library sources.

cards.entity_name: Martin Luther King Jr. and Coretta Scott King Lecture Series
cards.title: Join the MLK Lecture
cards.subtitle: Sarazen Student Union, Maloney Great Room
cards.notes: Watch Siena’s event calendar for the next annual keynote, then bring a friend for the public lecture and stay for the conversation.
cards.short_summary: A campus lecture series on race and nonviolent social change.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena states that its 2026 MLK Lecture Series keynote was free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 keynote was at the Sarazen Student Union and was free and open to the public; check the series page for future dates.

cards.title: Explore science hands-on
cards.subtitle: Nobel Hall, Siena University
cards.notes: Bring younger friends or family to the next announced Expedition to rotate through science demonstrations and hands-on activity stations.
cards.short_summary: A family-friendly science exploration event in Nobel Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena describes the Great Siena Expedition as free to attend, open to all ages, and requiring no registration.
cards.source_title: The Great Siena Expedition | Siena University
cards.access_notes: The cited event was held May 2, 2026; follow the official page for a future offering before making plans.

cards.title: Browse the Free Use Closet
cards.subtitle: Siena University campus pop-up
cards.notes: Check Student Activities announcements for a pop-up, then swap or select clothing with friends while keeping usable items in circulation.
cards.short_summary: A Siena clothing-sharing initiative with free items.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena reported that the Free Use Closet offered casual, party, and professional clothes free of charge to any attendee.
cards.source_title: Changing Perceptions of “Professional” in the Workplace | Siena University
cards.access_notes: This is a pop-up initiative rather than a confirmed permanent service; confirm a current campus date and location first.

cards.title: Work through a course together
cards.subtitle: Academic Success Center, Fr. Ben Kuhn House
cards.notes: Book a group tutoring session when a class gets challenging, and use the shared time to compare approaches and plan the next study block.
cards.short_summary: Free academic support for Siena students.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena says it offers group tutoring free of charge for all students.
cards.access_notes: For Siena students; arrange group tutoring through the Academic Success Center.

cards.title: Get one-on-one study help
cards.subtitle: Academic Success Center, Fr. Ben Kuhn House
cards.notes: Schedule an individual session for focused help on a difficult topic, then leave with a concrete plan for the next assignment.
cards.short_summary: Free one-to-one academic support for Siena students.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena says it offers individual tutoring free of charge for all students.
cards.access_notes: For Siena students; request individual tutoring through the Academic Success Center.

cards.entity_name: J. Spencer and Patricia Standish Library
cards.title: Settle in at Standish Library
cards.subtitle: Siena University campus
cards.notes: Bring your Saint Card, pick a study destination, and use the library’s materials and resources for a quiet shared work session.
cards.short_summary: A campus library accessible through the Siena Saint Card.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena states that a Saint Card provides full access to Standish Library resource materials.
cards.access_notes: Siena community access uses the Saint Card; the cited source says new student and employee cards are issued at no charge.

cards.title: Ride CDTA with your Saint Card
cards.subtitle: Capital District Transportation Authority service
cards.notes: Use your Saint Card to take a daytime bus ride with friends to an Albany destination, then confirm the route and return trip beforehand.
cards.short_summary: Student transit access connecting Siena with the Capital Region.
cards.evidence_claim: Siena states that students can ride CDTA bus service for free using the Saint Card.
cards.access_notes: For Siena students with a Saint Card; consult CDTA’s current route and service information before traveling.

cards.title: Pick a library program together
cards.subtitle: Albany Public Library branches
cards.notes: Choose an upcoming public program from the guide, confirm its branch and registration details, and make it a low-key off-campus outing.
cards.short_summary: Free public activities at Albany’s neighborhood libraries.
cards.evidence_claim: Albany Public Library says its program guide lists free activities, programs, and events available to the public.
cards.access_notes: Programs can change; use the current guide or events calendar to verify the date, location, and any registration requirement.

cards.title: Get an Albany library card
cards.subtitle: Albany Public Library
cards.notes: Bring your Siena student ID to an Albany Public Library branch and set up borrowing access for books, magazines, computers, and databases.
cards.short_summary: Library access for students living on campus in Albany or Rensselaer counties.
cards.evidence_claim: Albany Public Library says students living on campus at a college in Albany or Rensselaer counties may apply for a Student Card using student ID.
cards.source_title: Get a Card | Albany Public Library
cards.access_notes: Available to eligible campus residents with student ID; the source states Student Cards have the same borrowing privileges as Adult Resident Cards.

cards.title: Connect at North Albany Branch
cards.subtitle: Albany Public Library, 616 North Pearl Street
cards.notes: Meet at a table, use the branch’s free Wi-Fi for a project or planning session, and check current hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A public library branch with Wi-Fi, computers, and study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Albany Public Library lists free Wi-Fi, public-access computers, a program room, and study rooms at its North Albany Branch.
cards.source_title: North Albany Branch | Albany Public Library
cards.access_notes: Public branch; the official page lists current location hours and notes that borrowing a Chromebook requires a library card.

warnings: Some event-based cards require checking the official listing for a future date; no purchase or admission charge is stated in their cited sources.
